description: Agents record task progress in the task's handoff.md (format in workflow.md, nudged every turn, shown at SessionStart for Claude and Codex); release waits for npm visibility
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- `workflow.md`: new "Recording task progress" section — after each milestone, append an entry (State / Env / Next / Blockers / Evidence) to the active task's `handoff.md`. Planning and in_progress breadcrumbs point to it. The file is local and travels with the task branch; nothing is pushed.
- Per-turn breadcrumb (`inject-workflow-state.py`): for planning and in_progress tasks, a progress line shows "no entry yet" or the last entry time and commits since, so an unrecorded milestone is visible every turn.
- SessionStart (Claude template `shared-hooks/session-start.py` and Codex `codex/hooks/session-start.py`): each injects the newest 40 lines of its own active task's `handoff.md`, resolving the task with its own platform's session binding. Shared reader: `.trellis/scripts/common/task_handoff.py`.

**Release workflow:**
- `publish.yml` waits up to 20 minutes for a new version to become visible on npm and retries downloading the published tarball on a rerun.
notes: Run `npx -y c12-trellis@0.6.19 update`. No file migrations required.
